backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.hint: Full zip backup for disaster recovery, or JSON export/import for website content (products, articles, config, menu).
backup.fullHint: Compress the entire database and uploaded media into a zip file. Before every restore, the current state is automatically backed up (pre-restore).

job.runningRestore: Restoring — do not close or restart the server...
job.completedRestore: Restore completed. Current data was backed up beforehand as {{file}}. Reload the page — you may need to sign in again.

restorePrompt.title: Restore system?
restorePrompt.description: All current data (database and media library) will be REPLACED by the contents of "{{file}}". The current state is automatically backed up first, but this is still a system-wide destructive action.

deletePrompt.title: Delete backup?
deletePrompt.description: "{{file}}" will be permanently deleted from the server.

toasts.jobRunning: Another backup/restore job is already running

content.hint: Export/import JSON for articles, products, config, and menu. Excludes accounts, API keys, customers, and orders.
content.loadTablesError: Could not load the table list. Reload the page or try again.
content.customerSafeNote: Customer data, accounts, and API keys are always excluded — never modified on import.
content.mediaExportWarning: JSON export only includes image metadata/URLs (card_media, image) — not files under static/. Use full zip backup or copy static/ when moving servers.
content.replaceGroupWarning: Replace auto-expands to the full related table group (e.g. selecting product also includes product_variant, price…). The JSON file must contain all tables in that group.

modes.mergeHint: Upsert by ID. Existing rows not in the file are kept. Recommended for products and articles.
modes.replaceHint: Clear selected tables then load from file. Use for config/menu when you want a full sync.

importPrompt.title: Import content?
importPrompt.description: File "{{file}}" will import {{count}} tables in {{mode}} mode. A full zip backup runs automatically first. Customer data is not modified.

job.runningImport: Importing JSON — do not close the server...
job.completedImport: Import completed. Previous data was zip-backed up as {{file}}.

seed.hint: Export/import the seed dataset (store, region, shipping, products, content, menu) — shared with export-initial-data.ts / initial-data-seed.ts. Import runs idempotently: missing products/regions/shipping are created, while cards/posts/menu are updated to match the file.

importPrompt.title: Import seed data?
importPrompt.description: File "{{file}}" will be loaded through initial-data-seed.ts: missing products/regions/shipping are created, while cards/posts/menu are updated to match the file content. A full zip backup runs automatically first.

job.runningImport: Importing seed data — do not close the server...
job.completedImport: Import completed. Previous data was zip-backed up as {{file}}.
